entry_points.summary: Slash command: locate plugin root, detect mode (symlink/runtime/tarball), pull or atomic-swap, emit harness_updated
Writes or updates ~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json with z-harness personal marketplace entry
Creates ~/plugins/z-harness symlink, calls write_codex_marketplace, runs codex plugin add z-harness@personal
Copies scripts/export-*.py to install destination; only invoked with --legacy; deprecated, REMOVE-AT next minor
Downloads tarball (curl/wget), extracts to temp, handles single-top-dir shape, atomically moves to destination
Extracts tarball into Claude plugin location; optionally installs legacy exporters
Extracts tarball into Codex plugin location, updates marketplace.json, registers with codex plugin add

Emits JSON: z_harness_version (git SHA), z_harness_dirty, z_harness_branch, optional z_harness_tag; Z_HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT|ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_ROOT|CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT resolution; non-git sentinels on missing history
Builds dist/z-harness-<version>.tar.gz; excludes plans/archive/exports/providers.json + auto-detected legacy plan dirs; runs audit, deletes on failure

invariants: No autoupdate — all updates are explicitly user-triggered via /z-update or z-update skill.
Symlink mode aborts if git status --porcelain is non-empty; user must resolve before updating.
Symlink mode uses git pull --ff-only; diverged branches are rejected without force-merge or reset.
Tarball and runtime modes use atomic swap: old dir moved aside before new dir moves in; restored on failure.
A harness_updated event with old_version and new_version is emitted to metrics.jsonl on every successful update.
bundle-plugin.sh deletes the output tarball and exits non-zero if audit-tarball.sh fails.
version.sh emits non-git sentinel values (non-git/unknown) rather than erroring when plugin dir has no git history.
Plugin root resolution checks Z_HARNESS_PLUGIN_ROOT -> ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_ROOT -> CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT -> candidate paths.
If Z_HARNESS_RELEASE_URL is unset and the URL is still the example.com placeholder, /z-update halts and prompts the user.
install.sh --legacy is deprecated; available for one minor release only; REMOVE-AT annotation present in source.
gotchas: Three install modes: symlink (-L or git rev-parse succeeds), runtime (runtime/ dir present, no git), tarball (everything else).
Runtime mode is now distinct: runtime/ present but no .git/; atomic swap updates the full dir including runtime/drivers/ tree.
Legacy layout detection: if exports/codex|agy|cursor present but runtime/ absent, /z-update emits migration_nudge event and prints a one-line prompt; update still completes.
Tarball release URL is a placeholder in commands/z-update.md; Z_HARNESS_RELEASE_URL must be set for tarball/runtime updates to work.
Codex caches plugin skills; after symlink update /z-update reruns codex plugin add z-harness@personal, but a new thread is still required.
Symlink-mode detection checks -L (symlink) OR git rev-parse success; a tarball with .git/ inside would be misclassified as symlink mode.
bundle-plugin.sh excludes legacy plan dirs by scanning z-harness/<slug>/ for PLAN.md/SPEC.md/TASKS.md at bundle time — new plan dirs auto-excluded.
--force in install.sh removes a non-symlink existing install (rm -rf); does not affect symlink installs, which are always replaced.
install.sh --target=all requires both Claude layout (.git+commands+agents+runtime) and Codex layout (.git+.codex-plugin/plugin.json+skills).
--legacy flag in install.sh is a no-op in symlink mode (repo symlink exposes scripts directly) but still prints the deprecation notice.
